1.t: By the sky full of constellations

3.t: and the witness and what is witnessed

4.t: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—

7.t: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers

8.t: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—
8.tr: Wa-maa naqamoo minhum illaaa ai yu'minoo billaahil 'azeezil Hameed

9.t: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things
9.tr: Allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal-ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai-'in Shaheed

10.t: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning
10.tr: Innal lazeena fatanul mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati summa lam yatooboo falahum 'azaabu Jahannama Wa-lahum 'azaabul hareeq

11.t: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph
11.tr: Innal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati lahum Jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal fawzul kabeer

12.t: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe

13.t: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺

14.t: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—

15.t: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious

17.t: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—

19.t: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial

20.t: But Allah encompasses them from all sides

21.t: In fact, this is a glorious Quran
